item.title: The twenty twenty-eight threshold
item.description: Jack Clark assigns sixty percent or better odds to fully autonomous AI R&D by end of twenty twenty-eight — this week covers that analysis alongside new benchmarks for military AI compliance, AIGC detector evasion, hidden fine-tuning detection, and what the cumulative safety research picture implies for the governance window.
